Each and every stupa and temple has pillars erected reaching to the heavens; these pillars stand in rows by hundreds, thousands, and tens of millions. Such is the manner in which offerings are seen to be presented.
For as many eons as there are grains of sand in the Ganges, one serves the stupas, temples, banners, canopies, incense, and flowers raised within a single Buddha-world in this manner.

If one hears even a single verse of this sutra and proclaims it with praise without harboring any doubt, the merit of being established in that single name will exceed the former; furthermore, such a person shall be as one who makes offerings to me, the God among Gods, being able to uphold and practice [this teaching] without violating the prohibitions and precepts.

"If there are those of clear wisdom who hear the name of this samādhi, they shall behold Buddhas as numerous as the sands of the Ganges; they shall also be able to reverently attend to and serve them. These Holy Ones among bipeds possess infinite majestic power; they shall preach the sūtras and remain ever free from negligence, never forgetting for countless billions of kalpas."

"Those who have previously seen the Lion of the Past expound this sublime sūtra, the extraordinary King of Paths, will find joy upon hearing it in this final age. Having previously received instruction from the World-Honored One, they cast off the nets of fetters and the defilement of impurities; they eliminate all evil conduct like filthy excrement emerging from greed. These are called those with eyes; they delight in dwelling in seclusion and never again run about in distraction."

That person originally resided in the city of Vaiśālī; because they once heard the Buddha preach this sutra, took refuge in the Tathāgata, and beheld the Jewel Net, they shall uphold this sutra in the future final age and preach it for disciples as I have instructed.

Their conduct is noble and sublime, their merit flourishes, and out of compassion for sentient beings, they deliver those in the various streams of existence; in the final age of the Dharma's decline, they shall uphold this sutra and make offerings to incalculable Buddhas—such as these are the ones who, in the final age of the Dharma's decline, shall uphold the Buddha-dharma.

"If one were to purify the Brahma-conduct for billions of kalpas while remaining in the world, performing incalculable accumulations of merit, the merit of one who hears this sutra in the future final age would surpass that, being beyond measure; such a person will receive and uphold the scriptures with bottomless refinement of thought and travel through immeasurable assemblies in various Buddha-lands."

They shall behold all the Perfectly Awakened Ones preaching the infinite Dharma; they shall see the Tathāgatas Amitābha and Akṣobhya, as well as these guides of humanity—Vimalaprabhārcis and Siṃhacandrarāja—and thereafter, in the final age, they shall uphold this sutra.
Furthermore, if one wishes to see Maitreya Tathāgata, the stainless Great Holy Lion-Valiant Tathāgata, or the Honored One of Radiance, it shall be likewise.
Thereafter, in the final age, one shall uphold the Buddha-dharma and accord with such peerless and sublime sūtras as these.

Now the Tathāgata speaks for the sake of Ratnajāla: you yourself should practice this in future generations; do not remain or abide in a state of negligence, but without violating the prohibitions and precepts, always remain free from negligence, and practice this in future times.

At the end of your life, you shall swiftly be reborn in the world above, the most supreme Buddha-land of Immeasurable Radiance; that world is named Jewel Sovereign. Once your life there has ended, you shall before long encounter and behold the Perfectly Enlightened Maitreya.

When the Buddha had spoken thus, the youth Ratnajālin, forty trillion bodhisattvas including Maitreya Bodhisattva, six billion arhats, nine billion devas, worldlings, and asuras, having heard what the Buddha taught, were all filled with joy; they paid their respects and withdrew.
